items.title: "Catch-up" Cognitive Growth in Filipino Children
items.notes: Printed under the "Feature" label; an honors thesis per the contributors page. The opening page names Dr. William Leonard as Thesis Adviser, Dr. Helen Schwartzman and Dr. Christopher Kuzawa as Secondary Advisers, and Sadaf Hasnain and Jared Briggs as Graduate Mentors. The contents page gives the department as Anthropology; the contributors page says the author graduates in 2013 with a degree in Anthropology (Human Biology) and Global Health. Tables and figure captions on printed pages 13 and 15 are split into many small blocks.

items.title: The Number One (Digital) Princess in the World: VOCALOID, Hatsune Miku, and the Blending of Humanity and Technology
items.notes: Printed under the "Feature" label. Adviser named on the opening page ("Dr. Scott Paulin, Adviser"). An asterisk after "World" in the printed title marks a footnote and is omitted here. The contributors page says the author is a senior studying English Literature.

items.title: Mental Health In A Himalayan Nomadic Community: The Impact Of A Changing Lifestyle On The Expressions and Healing of Mental Distress
items.notes: Abstract only (printed under the "Abstract" label). The opening page reads "Department of Anthropology" and "Adviser: Helen Schwartzman". The contributors page says the author is a senior majoring in anthropology.

items.title: The Paris of Latin America: ¿Sos Bienvenido?
items.notes: The opening page names Elisa Baena as Faculty Sponsor and Mentor and "Helen Schwartman" (spelled so) as Thesis Adviser. Printed page 31 has no text in the capture beyond page furniture (apparently a full-page photo). The contributors page says the author earned a BA in Anthropology with a minor in Psychology.

items.title: Examining the Political and Economic Effects of the Australian Carbon Tax
items.notes: Printed under the "Abstract" label. The opening page reads "Lynne Kiesling, Adviser - Department of Economics". Printed page 32 holds only the title block. The text of printed pages 33-34 is badly jumbled in the capture: two columns are interleaved line by line, footnotes are mixed into the body, and part of page 34 is extracted one word per line. The contributors page says the author is a senior studying Social Policy and International Studies.

items.title: HIGHER EDUCATION ALTERNATIVES FOR DISADVANTAGED STUDENTS
items.notes: Title and author are printed in capitals on the opening page; the contents page gives "Higher Education Alternatives for Disadvantaged Students" by "Andrea Marcos". Faculty Adviser James Rosenbaum is named on the opening page. A thesis; the contributors page says the author studied Mathematical Methods in the Social Sciences and Sociology and graduated in June 2012 with joint honors. The table bodies (Tables 1-5) and the contents of Appendix A are not in the capture, only their captions and headings.
